findings.detail: Only one template option means I don't really get to choose a design.
findings.proposed_solution: Offer more template choices to give me design flexibility.

findings.detail: The site content is placeholder, not my actual business info, which makes it hard to visualize.
findings.proposed_solution: Pre-populate the site with my actual business information or guide me to input it immediately.

findings.detail: Having a chat feature is nice, but I'm not sure what it's for yet.
findings.proposed_solution: Clarify the purpose of the chat feature early on (e.g., 'Chat with AI for design help').
